overall.summary: The change is straightforward and validated, with one small source of policy drift worth consolidating.

observations.title: Duplicated eligibility policy
observations.principle: A business decision should have one authoritative implementation.
observations.summary: Preview and Apply encode the same eligibility rule independently.
observations.impact: A future policy change can make the preview disagree with the operation it predicts.
observations.recommendation: Extract the eligibility decision into one private function used by both paths.
observations.tradeoffs: This adds a small indirection, but it removes a meaningful consistency hazard without introducing a new abstraction layer.

evidence.detail: Preview evaluates active status and country inline.
Apply repeats the inverse of the same policy.
